Specification: This module specifies a PlusCal algorithm translated into TLA+ for a small multiprocess system with one distinguished process ProcA and two ProcB processes. The system models procedure calls to a shared Sum procedure using explicit program counters, per-process stacks, and saved local variables, while updating a shared sum and a done set as processes complete. The specification checks temporal progress toward termination using weak fairness on process and procedure actions, and it includes a terminating stuttering action to avoid deadlock after all processes reach the "Done" control state.
